sessions.description: [Track B] Conference Chair welcomes 350 senior delegates, frames the day's regulatory and digital health agenda, and acknowledges Platinum and Strategic Partners.

sessions.title: Keynote: Digital Transformation in Regional Healthcare
sessions.description: [Track C] Headline policy keynote on national digital health strategy, interoperability mandates, and the next phase of regional healthcare modernization.

sessions.title: Panel: Regulatory Reliance and Cross-Border Collaboration
sessions.description: Three-person panel exploring GCC regulatory reliance pathways, joint reviews, and cross-border data and clinical trial collaboration. Includes 10 minutes audience Q&A.

sessions.title: Sponsor Spotlight: Platinum Sponsor
sessions.description: [Track B] Branded 10-minute spotlight from the Platinum Sponsor on AI-enabled diagnostics deployments across the region.

sessions.title: Fireside Chat: AI in Clinical Research
sessions.description: Two-chair fireside on operationalizing AI in regional clinical research — protocol design, regulatory acceptance, and patient safety guardrails.

sessions.title: Workshop: Building Patient-Centric Digital Health Pathways
sessions.description: Facilitated working session with break-out tables. Delegates map a patient journey across primary care, specialist referral, and remote monitoring touchpoints.

sessions.title: Closing Remarks
sessions.description: Conference Chair closes the program with key takeaways, partner thank-yous, and next-year save-the-date.

gccEvent.avRequirements: Main stage with dual 16:9 projection screens and center IMAG. Four lavalier mics (panel) + two handhelds for audience Q&A + one lectern mic (gooseneck) for keynote. Confidence monitor downstage center showing speaker timer and next-cue prompt. FOH desk at rear-of-house with comms to stage manager, lighting, and video. Walk-on music presets loaded for keynote, panel, fireside, and workshop. Lower-thirds package preloaded in order of run. Sponsor video loops queued for breaks. Live captioning feed for keynote and panel. Registration desk with 4 check-in stations, badge printers, and overflow queue managers. Sponsor area with 6 pods adjacent to coffee service. Backup wireless mic kit and spare lav packs in green room.
